[[File:Options Button.png|frameless|left]]
The Options Menu offers many ways to customize the Idle Obelisk Miner experience.


==General Game Settings==
<tabber class="sticky-header">
Music and Sound Effects=
To mute all sound effects or music, use the buttons in the bottom right of the main menu.
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Mute All Music || Mute the ingame music
|-
| Mute All Sound Effects || Mutes sound effects (bomb explosions, pickaxe mining, etc)
|-
| Mute All Bomb Sounds || Mutes all the bomb sounds in the game.
|}
|-|
Bombs/Inventory=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Disable All Bomb Animations || Disables the animation of the bomb flying from the bomb bag then expanding in the center of the screen.<br>[[File:CheckboxIcon.png|16px]] Recommended at high Game Speed.
|-
| Chain Bomb Ignores Floor Pausing || Uses Chain Bomb Charges even when drones are paused.<br>[[File:CheckboxIcon.png|16px]] Recommended unless you are pausing to manually fire bombs as auto fired bombs will always hit first.
|-
| Make Transmuter Bomb Do No Damage || Transmuter Bomb will do 0 damage (unless fired with Fire All mode).<br>[[File:CheckboxIcon.png|16px]] Recommended when using a [[Obelisk:FAQ#What_is_the_"Spoon_Strat"?|spoon]] to stack Bomb of Plenty and Transmuter Bomb effects.
|-
| Enable Use 1000x Items || Enables use 1000x item mode in the item bag. Unlocked at Obelisk 50.
|-
| Bomb Cooldown shows time to cap or run out || Switch from recharge rate per bomb to total time until reaching bomb cap
|-
| Disable Confirmation on Fire All Bombs || Tap once to fire bombs instead of twice when in fire-all bombs mode
|}
|-|
Quality of Life=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Auto-Loot free Lootbug offerings || Automatically collects the free Lootbug rewards when looting Lootbugs one by one (has no effect when using Loot-All)
|-
| Remove Lootbug Gem confirmation || Removes the gem confirmation (have to tap twice to spend gems) when looting Lootbugs one by one (has no effect when using Loot-All)
|-
| Enable Loot-All Banked Lootbugs || Enables tapping the Banked Lootbug Icon on the left side of the main screen to open the Loot-All Banked Lootbug dialog.
|-
| Tap any Lootbug to Loot-All || Enables opening the Loot-All Banked Lootbug dialog when tapping any Lootbug. Does not need Enable Loot-All Banked Lootbugs setting to be on to work.<br>[[File:CheckboxIcon.png|16px]] Recommended setting.
|-
| One Click Claim all Banked Freebies || Claims all Banked Freebie Packs with one click of the Claim button.<br>[[File:CheckboxIcon.png|16px]] Recommended setting.
|}
|-|
Popups/Displays=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Disable Ore Damage Popups || Hides popups for all types of damage to ores.
|-
| Timers Show True Timer After Game Speed || Factors in Game Speed to timers for Items, Buffs and Drone Fuel.<br>[[File:CheckboxIcon.png|16px]] Recommended setting.
|-
| Disable Bomb-Bag/Drone Pause tooltips || Hides text on Drone pause button, Drone pause on floor button, and Auto-Bomb Consumes Cherry Stack button.
|-
| More Compact Text Popups || Makes popups for Lootbug rewards, Freebies and Elixir buffs appear on the left side of the screen with a smaller background.
|-
| Show Miner At Top of UI || Shows the Miner at the top of the main screen.
|-
| Disable Floor Movement Buttons || Hides Floor Movement Buttons on the right side of the main screen. Can be useful for Challenges where you need to stay below a certain floor.
|-
| Notation ||
* Standard: Numbers are abbreviated with the short abbreviated number notation. (123m, 1.23b)
* Scientific: Numbers are abbreviated with the short abbreviated number notation. (123m, 1.23b)
* Engineering: Numbers are abbreviated with the engineering notation. (123e6, 1.23e9)
|-
| Extra Notation Digits || Show extra digits (+0, +1, +2, or +3)
|-
| Disable Opening Gifts || Gift button becomes transparent and cannot be interacted with
|-
| Hide Left Side Timers Above 100d || Hides buffs and drone timers above 100 days. Works also with the True Time option turned on.
|-
| Popup When The Game Locally Saves || Enables the option to download the local save on your device instead of the cloud save when reinstalling the game.
|-
| Turn on Battery Saver Screen || Activates a screen that shows basic information on the game. Designed to save battery and avoid burn in. Can also open by double tapping the battery icon in the main menu.
|}
|-|
Offline Settings=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Consume Buff Timers and Items Buffs offline || Uses Buff and Item duration to boost offline gains. Buffs generated by Elixir drone get used regardless of this setting.
|-
| Consume Drone Fuel Timers offline || Uses Drone Fuel loaded in the equipped Drone Suits to improve offline gains.
|-
| Notify When Offline Timer Caps || Sends a notification when the offline timer caps. 12 hours by default or 24 hours with [[Founder]].
|-
| Notify When Banked Freebies Full || Sends a notification when your banked freebies are full. The notification time is calculated based on the current Game Speed value, so if the Game Speed buff duration runs out while offline, freebies won't be full.
|-
| Notify When Banked Lootbugs Full || Sends a notification when your banked Lootbugs are full. 
|-
| Show Last Offline Results || Opens the last offline results again.
|}
|-|
Graphics=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Consistent Ore Position || Ores spawn in the same position each time.
|-
| Minimize Mining Effects To Stop Flashing || Disables the darkening of destroyed ore nodes.
|-
| Hide Chest Meters || Hides the Chest Meters on the left side of the main screen.
|-
| Hide Golden Floor Effects || Uses the default background art instead of the Golden Floor background art on Golden Floors.
|-
| Hide Rainbow Floor Effects || Hides the Rainbow Floor overlay on Rainbow Floors.
|-
| Hide Golden Ore and Icon || Shows the default Ore sprites instead of the Golden Ore sprites for Golden Ores. Hides the Golden Ore icon.
|-
| Hide All Vein Effects (Golden etc.) || Uses the default Vein sprites for upgraded Veins.
|-
| Hide Veins Entirely (Show Ore Instead) || Shows the Ore sprite even when the Ore has been upgraded to a Vein.
|-
| Cloud Zone Brightness Reduction || Uses alternate background art in the Cloud Zone.
|}
|-|
Drones=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Hide Maxed Drone/Coal Upgrades || Hides your drone and coal upgrades when they are fully upgraded.
|-
| Disable Drone radius display || Disables the circle around the drones indicating their radius of attack.
|-
| Make Drones Invisible || Hides the drones. They are still working! Disable them from the bomb bag if you do not want them to do damage.
|-
| Hide Void Portal Resource Gain Popups || Hides only the resources gained through void portals.
|-
| Hide Coal Full Popup || Hides the coal full popup that pops up when the generator has filled your coal storage.
|}
</tabber>

==Specific Menu Settings==
<tabber class="sticky-header">
Artifacts=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Hide Maxed Artifact Upgrades || Hides your artifacts upgrades when they are fully upgraded.
|}
|-|
Challenges=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Hide Maxed Challenge Upgrades || Hides your challenge upgrades when they are fully upgraded.
|}

|-|
Contracts=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Hide Maxed Contract Upgrades || Hides your contract upgrades when they are fully upgraded.
|-
| Enable Bulk Contract Auto-Complete || Enables the buying of one-click buy all the contracts that you can. Otherwise they are bought one by one in quick succession.<br>[[File:CheckboxIcon.png|16px]] Recommended unless you want to limit how many contracts you complete.
|}
|-|
Pets=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Hide Max Level Pets (With Cards Complete) || Hides your pets in the pet page once you have maxed their level out completely and you got their current max card rarity.
|-
| Hide Max Level Pet Quests || Hides the pet quests once they are max rank.
|-
| Make Pets Invisible || Hides the pets on the main screen. You will not see these cuties outside of the menu anymore.
|}
|-|
Stargazing=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Make Stars Invisible || Hides all stars
|-
| Hide Maxed Stars in Stars Tab || Hides your starts once they have reached their current max level.
|-
| Hide All Maxed Stargazing Upgrades || Hides your upgrades in the stargazing page once they are fully upgraded.
|}
|-|
Archaeology=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Hide All Maxed Archaeology Upgrades || Hides your upgrades in the archaeology page once they are fully upgraded.
|}
|-|
Fishing=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Hide All Maxed Fishing Upgrades || Hides your upgrades in the fishing page once they are fully upgraded.
|-
| Hide Processed Fishing Ticks Popup || Hides the fishing ticks popup in the fishing/docks page that opens when calculating fishing ticks.
|-
| Fishing Ticks Process 10x Faster || Your fishing ticks will be processed 10x faster.
|-
| Assignment Buttons on the right || Changes the side of the drones' and fisher's assignment buttons from the left to the right. The fishes move accordingly from right to left. Useful if playing with only the right hand.
|}
|-|
Arcanist=
{|class="wikitable align-left-2"
! Option !! Description
|-
| Hide All Maxed Essence Upgrades || Hides your upgrades in the Essence page once they are fully upgraded.
|-
| Hide All Maxed Exchange Upgrades || Hides your upgrades in the Exchange page once they are fully upgraded.
|}
